adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered local Source Data XLSX activity/toxicity rows, reconciled linked DBAASP/APD6 records against primary article/source-data locators, closed the framework-test rework ticket, and preserves database-only/APD computed-annotation plus source-data caption cautions without claiming accepted_clean.

caution_findings.note: Fig. 1a supports CpoBD13 identity, but APD6 computed sequence-similarity/composition/property text is database-only and is not promoted to primary-source evidence.
Primary source data are cell-viability percentages; database cell-death bins are reconciled by 100 minus viability at 100 µM and kept with rounding/bin context.

Source Data Fig. 4B lists numeric H21A IC50 replicates, while the Fig. 4 caption says H21A IC50 could not be determined within the assessed range; the row is retained with caution rather than smoothed.
File inspection shows repeated HTML landing pages; row-level source data were recovered from the true local XLSX.
The original rework ticket is repaired, but accepted_clean is not claimed.

supplementary_assets.note: MOESM5 source-data XLSX recovered row-level assay data; repeated landed .bin files are HTML landing pages and do not block worker-2/4/6 adjudication.
